Source D2 explicitly states '1st arrondissement of Paris... is one of the 20 arrondissements of the capital city of France', identifying Paris as a valid answer. Since distinct valid namesakes exist (Lyon and Paris both have a 1st arrondissement), both are retained as complementary answers rather than collapsing to a single winner.
